xgboost.name: XGBoost
xgboost.what: Trees added one at a time, each correcting the last. The usual accuracy leader.
xgboost.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

extra-trees.name: Extra Trees
extra-trees.what: Random forest with random split points: faster, smoother.
extra-trees.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

histgradientboosting.name: HistGradientBoosting
histgradientboosting.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

lightgbm.name: LightGBM
lightgbm.what: Gradient boosting that grows trees leaf by leaf; quick on wide tables.
lightgbm.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

mlp.name: MLP
mlp.pre: Numbers: median fill and scaling. Categories: most-frequent fill and one-hot.

random-forest.name: Random Forest
random-forest.what: Hundreds of decision trees, each on a random slice, averaged.
random-forest.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

explainable-boosting.name: Explainable Boosting
explainable-boosting.what: Boosting kept additive: one curve per predictor, so every score can be read.
explainable-boosting.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

spline-logistic.name: Spline logistic
spline-logistic.what: Logistic regression whose curves can bend, so age and distance need not be straight lines.
spline-logistic.pre: Numbers: median fill and scaling. Categories: most-frequent fill and one-hot.

logistic-regression.name: Logistic regression
logistic-regression.what: A weighted sum of the predictors, turned into a chance. The plain baseline.
logistic-regression.pre: Numbers: median fill and scaling. Categories: most-frequent fill and one-hot.

elastic-net-logistic.name: Elastic net logistic
elastic-net-logistic.what: Logistic regression that shrinks weak predictors towards zero, and drops some.
elastic-net-logistic.pre: Numbers: median fill and scaling. Categories: most-frequent fill and one-hot.

stacked-ensemble.name: Stacked ensemble
stacked-ensemble.what: A logistic blend of the other models' predictions.
stacked-ensemble.pre: Works on the base models' predictions.

cumulative-link-ensemble.name: Cumulative-link ensemble
cumulative-link-ensemble.what: Uses the visit count itself: models several thresholds and pools them.
cumulative-link-ensemble.pre: Works on the base models' predictions.

xgboost-isotonic-calibrated.name: XGBoost (isotonic calibrated)
xgboost-isotonic-calibrated.what: XGBoost, recalibrated by isotonic scaling fitted on inner folds.
xgboost-isotonic-calibrated.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

xgboost-platt-calibrated.name: XGBoost (platt calibrated)
xgboost-platt-calibrated.what: XGBoost, recalibrated by Platt scaling fitted on inner folds.
xgboost-platt-calibrated.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

parsimonious.name: Parsimonious
parsimonious.what: A short list of predictors picked by forward selection.
parsimonious.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

ladder-transformer.name: Ladder transformer
ladder-transformer.what: A network with attention across predictors that scores all three rungs at once.
ladder-transformer.pre: Numbers scaled; every predictor becomes a token the network attends over.

contact-sequence-encoder-decoder.name: Contact-sequence encoder-decoder
contact-sequence-encoder-decoder.what: A network that walks the visits in order and stops where care stops.
contact-sequence-encoder-decoder.pre: Numbers scaled; every predictor becomes a token the network attends over.

histgradientboosting-isotonic-calibrated.name: HistGradientBoosting (isotonic calibrated)
histgradientboosting-isotonic-calibrated.what: HistGradientBoosting, recalibrated by isotonic scaling fitted on inner folds.
histgradientboosting-isotonic-calibrated.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

histgradientboosting-platt-calibrated.name: HistGradientBoosting (platt calibrated)
histgradientboosting-platt-calibrated.what: HistGradientBoosting, recalibrated by Platt scaling fitted on inner folds.
histgradientboosting-platt-calibrated.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

catboost.name: CatBoost
catboost.what: Gradient boosting built to handle categories directly.
catboost.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

logistic-regression-21.name: Logistic regression · 21 predictors
logistic-regression-21.what: A weighted sum of the predictors, turned into a chance. The plain baseline. Uses only the 21 predictors.
logistic-regression-21.pre: Numbers: median fill and scaling. Categories: most-frequent fill and one-hot.

random-forest-21.name: Random Forest · 21 predictors
random-forest-21.what: Hundreds of decision trees, each on a random slice, averaged. Uses only the 21 predictors.
random-forest-21.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

xgboost-21.name: XGBoost · 21 predictors
xgboost-21.what: Trees added one at a time, each correcting the last. The usual accuracy leader. Uses only the 21 predictors.
xgboost-21.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.
